report.verdict: A senior backend engineer in payments, with a strong ledger project but little about the work in each job.
write_up: You're a senior backend engineer working on payouts and ledger services, with a Go reconciliation project. It's common to see a job described in one line and an earlier one left blank, but a recruiter may move on without knowing what you did in either role.
The ledger-recon project is the model: it names the library, the language, 1,200 GitHub stars and use by three payment companies. That work belongs much higher in the About section.

Start with the Northwind Pay job: say what you worked on within payouts and ledger services, and what changed. Then bring ledger-recon into the About and headline, and fill in the Kestrel Labs job. A recruiter can then assess your payments work without guessing what sits behind the titles.
